name: BentoHub
summary: App that builds a bento grid for your GitHub profile readme and exports it as HTML or Markdown.
description: BentoHub is a web app where you compose a bento grid for your GitHub profile readme and copy-paste the generated HTML or Markdown into it. Client built with React, shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS; Appwrite handles the backend.
contains: creates a bento grid for a GitHub profile readme
output is copy-paste HTML or Markdown
client: React, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS; server: Appwrite
the listed domain www.bentohub.online no longer serves the app
